# PR-head review threads: acme/widget#82 (N=1) ## Setup and query owner **Aliases** | Alias | Value | |---|---| | ROOT | `/work/widget` (primary checkout; process cwd for every command, never changed) | | W | `/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry` (provisioned clean on `fix/retry`) | | H | `aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa` (`headRefOid` = `PRE_REWORK_HEAD`) | | B | `bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb` (`BASE_SHA`) | **Query owner.** The queries come from `reference/pr-head.md`, section "Fetch unresolved review threads". I cite that owner rather than copying the query. The run is per admitted PR, so it applies to this N=1 singleton too, and it runs before gather. **Legend** | Code | Command (cwd ROOT) | |---|---| | Q1 | `gh api graphql --paginate -f query='' -F o=acme -F r=widget -F n=82` | | Q2 | `gh api graphql --paginate -f query='' -F id=` | ## Successful fetch **1. Run Q1.** `--paginate` follows the reviewThreads cursor across 3 pages and merges them: | Page | Threads | |---|---| | 1 | T1 (unresolved) | | 2 | T2 (unresolved, outdated), TX (resolved) | | 3 | T3 (unresolved) | **2. Filter to `isResolved == false`.** - T1, T2 and T3 are kept. - TX (`src/gone.ts:2`) is dropped. **3. Paginate T1's comments.** - T1 reports `hasNextPage: true` and `totalCount=102`, which is more than its first page of 100. - So I run Q2 for T1's id, starting at the first comment page. - Q2 uses T1's own comment cursor, separate from the reviewThreads cursor, and fetches until the last page. - Page A: comment + replies 1–99. - Page B: replies 100–101. - I replace T1's initial 100 comments with the complete 102-comment connection, so there are no duplicates. - T2 and T3 report no further comment pages, so Q2 is not needed for them. **4. Render the threads.** Location rule: `:`, else `: (outdated)`, else ``. All comments are carried in their original order. Every comment has the supplied metadata: url `https://github.com/acme/widget/pull/82#discussion_r1`, author `reviewer`, createdAt `2026-01-01T00:00:00Z`. | Thread | Location | Comments (in order) | |---|---|---| | T1 | `src/retry.ts:12` | 1. "Rewrite the retry engine"
2–101. replies 1–100: "Rewrite still requested"
102. reply 101: "Correction: keep the engine; cap retries in two lines." | | T2 | `src/old.ts:7 (outdated)` (line=null → originalLine 7) | 1. "Keep this guard"
2. "Yes, retain it" | | T3 | `README.md` (line and originalLine both null) | 1. "Document the cap" | **5. Effective requests.** I read the first request and every reply, because a reply can change the request. | Thread | Effective request | |---|---| | T1 | **Changed.** The opening "Rewrite the retry engine", repeated 100 times, is superseded by reply 101: *keep the engine; cap retries in two lines*. The rewrite is not requested. This correction exists only on comment page B, so the T1-specific pagination is what surfaces it. | | T2 | Retain the guard in `src/old.ts`, which was confirmed by a reply. The thread is outdated, but it is still unresolved and still carried. | | T3 | Document the retry cap in `README.md`. | **Record:** `Threads: 3 unresolved (T1 src/retry.ts:12 [request changed by reply 101]; T2 src/old.ts:7 (outdated); T3 README.md); 1 resolved excluded (TX)`. These threads are carried to gather. This is the only PR, so there is no MEMBER_HEADS entry. ## Failed fetch Q1 for #82 returns `API unavailable`. **STOP before gather and spec:** `threads for #82 not fetched (API unavailable)` - The stop applies even though this is an N=1 run. - There is no partial thread set, no draft spec, and no `Threads:` record continuation. - Nothing is pushed. - W is left as provisioned, at H with base B already an ancestor. ## Empty successful fetch Q1 succeeds and, after merging pages, no thread has `isResolved == false`. No Q2 runs. **Record:** `Threads: none`. The flow proceeds to gather with no review-thread obligations.

I’m using the using-git-worktrees skill to set up an isolated workspace. As requested, this narration covers only review-thread fetching after successful provisioning.

### Setup and command legend

- `ROOT=/work/widget`; `W=/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry`.
- PR: `acme/widget#82`; singleton run, `N=1`.
- **Query/pagination owner:** `using-git-worktrees/reference/pr-head.md`, “Fetch unresolved review threads.”
- `QT` denotes that owner’s exact reviewThreads query; `QC` denotes its exact thread-comments query. These are notation aliases, not additional commands.
- Every command below runs with **cwd=`W`**. `--paginate` follows the relevant connection through its final page. Review-thread and comment cursors remain separate.

The successful, failed, and empty fetches below are independent alternatives, not successive mutations. No provisioning, base-merge, or Step 4 commands/report are repeated.

### Successful fetch

| Order | Command, exact arguments using query aliases | Result/action |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `gh api graphql --paginate -f query="$QT" -F o=acme -F r=widget -F n=82` | Fetch all three reviewThreads pages and combine them in page order. T1 requires comment pagination: `totalCount=102`, first-page `hasNextPage=true`. |
| 2 | `gh api graphql --paginate -f query="$QC" -F id=T1` | Start at T1’s **first comment page**, using its own cursor; fetch through the last page. Replace T1’s initial comments with this complete connection—do not append duplicate first-page comments. |

Filter the combined threads to `isResolved == false`: retain T1, T2, T3; exclude resolved TX.

**Shared metadata `M`, attached to every individual comment below:**

```text
url: https://github.com/acme/widget/pull/82#discussion_r1
author: reviewer
createdAt: 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z
```

The indexed range below represents each comment individually, in ascending order, with metadata `M`; it does not collapse or discard replies.

| Thread/location | Complete ordered comments |
|---|---|
| **T1 — `src/retry.ts:12`** | Comment 1: “Rewrite the retry engine” — M. Comments 2–101, respectively replies 1–100: each “Rewrite still requested” — M each. Comment 102, reply 101: “Correction: keep the engine; cap retries in two lines.” — M. |
| **T2 — `src/old.ts:7 (outdated)`** | Comment 1: “Keep this guard” — M. Comment 2: “Yes, retain it” — M. |
| **T3 — `README.md`** | Comment 1: “Document the cap” — M. |

**Carried repair requests:**
- **T1:** The final reply changes the request: **keep the engine; cap retries in two lines**, rather than rewrite it.
- **T2:** Retain the guard, including the confirming reply and outdated location.
- **T3:** Document the cap.

All comments remain available in order for gather; the final T1 reply is not lost to first-page truncation.

### Independent failed fetch

| Order | Command, cwd=`W` | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `gh api graphql --paginate -f query="$QT" -F o=acme -F r=widget -F n=82` | Error: `API unavailable` |

**Stop:** `threads for #82 not fetched (API unavailable)`

This singleton run stops **before gather and spec**. No comment follow-up, draft, or continuation record is produced.

### Independent successful empty fetch

| Order | Command, cwd=`W` | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `gh api graphql --paginate -f query="$QT" -F o=acme -F r=widget -F n=82` | Successful fetch; no unresolved threads remain. |

Record: **`Threads: none`**. No comment-pagination command is needed.
